title: credential.loaded@1
description: A credential of a run's environment was loaded for the run (#1106): by value, into its processes' environment, or as a stand-in its egress filter swaps for the value only in requests to the credential's hosts. Names the variable, never the value. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

run.description: The run it was loaded for: a run: handle.

env.description: The variable the run's processes read it from.

by.description: value: the value itself is in the variable; stand-in: a random token per run is, and the egress filter puts the value into requests to its hosts.

x-closure.closed: each value is a way the record says a credential reached the run, and every reader acts on it, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

hosts.description: The hosts its value may go to, each host:port; only with a stand-in.
